mapper.select: SELECT dgui.id, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, oguon.game_id, ogon.name, ogon.`type`, oguon.`level`, oguon.played_num, dgui.create_time, dgui.update_time FROM ods_game_user_one_net oguon INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (oguon.user_id = dui.user_id) LEFT JOIN ods_game_one_net ogon on (ogon.id = oguon.game_id) LEFT JOIN dim_game_user_info dgui on (dgui.user_id = dui.user_id and dgui.game_id = oguon.game_id) WHERE oguon.id = #{gameUserId}
